acceptanceCriteria: too-many-claims and map-too-large refusals name the observed total, the fixed bound and a bounded per-scope breakdown, with refusal precedence and success bytes unchanged.
Focused tests fail on base and pass after; the spec failure-code rows are updated.
body: Found during V1-0522 (2026-10-09). internal/dogfoodocm/aggregate.go now names per-scope counts for too-many-obligations (OCM-V0-017 in the lane, renumbered on integration), but the sibling aggregate refusals too-many-claims and map-too-large still print only the code and a fixed message, with no observed total, bound or contributing scope. Expected: the same bounded diagnostic shape so an agent can tell which scope to drop or split. Actual: bare refusal. Suspected friction, from source reading.
title: OCM aggregate too-many-claims and map-too-large refusals give no counts or bound
